encoding.originals: Preserved unchanged in source directory; SHA-256 and dimensions recorded below.

audit.scope: All 46 nested-folder files visually reviewed. Original 92 records retained after recomputing every hash and image dimension across the combined 138-file tree.
audit.selectionAuthority: products is authoritative; original ten production sets retained. New closest-fit shared mappings explicitly identify their primary source owner.
audit.countingPolicy: 138 files = 26 collages + 4 unrelated posters + 3 canonical posters + 105 photographs, including 11 duplicate extra copies. Production assigns 72 roles from 63 distinct sources. Nine explicitly shared role assignments are not nine new images.
audit.similarityMethod: 63-bit DCT pHash, 64-bit dHash and grayscale SSIM at 128x128. Candidate pairs: pHash <= 12 OR dHash <= 10; human review decides duplication. Theme variants and similar subjects are not automatically duplicates.
